snc.text: The Mezzio is the busy middle tier of New Capenna, where Elspeth keeps her head down taking odd jobs until she hears a shopkeeper being beaten over a debt and intervenes against four Maestro enforcers.

She leads them on a chase through its streets to a half-built bridge, where she grabs a steel rod and knocks them all out without killing them, and Anhelo, watching, offers her work with the Maestros.
Vivien meets her Obscura contact Navy here, trading information about the Font and the Adversary's lounge, and later sees Elspeth fight off enforcers in the street.
At the lounge Vivien overhears that Navy is a double agent, and when Navy ambushes her outside, Vivien stabs her and takes her notebook; later Elspeth, Vivien and Giada flee across the Mezzio.
